CORE MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #17
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: CORE MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 18
   C. 90
   D. 36

2. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 12
   C. 36
   D. 42

3. Solve for x: x + 9 = 20. (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 11
   C. 9
   D. 20

4. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 40 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 43
   B. 41
   C. 31
   D. 49

5. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 0
   B. 8
   C. 17
   D. 16

6. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 1000 m²
   B. 100 000 m²
   C. 10 000 m²
   D. 100 m²

7. In the number 3141, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 400
   C. 40
   D. 10

8. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 9
   C. 82
   D. 18

9. Which list shows all factors of 6? (1 mark)
   A. 1, 6
   B. 2, 4, 6
   C. 1, 2, 3, 6
   D. 3, 6, 9

10. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 144
   C. 24
   D. 156

11. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 2
   C. 25
   D. 10

12. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 41
   B. 13
   C. 3
   D. 40

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

MARKING SCHEME
====

1. A — 81
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: Area of square = side × side
2. Substitute values: Area = 9 × 9
3. Area = 81
Final Answer: 81 m²
Mark reminder: method mark; accuracy mark

2. C — 36
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: Area of square = side × side
2. Substitute values: Area = 6 × 6
3. Area = 36
Final Answer: 36 m²
Mark reminder: method mark; accuracy mark

3. B — 11
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: x = RHS − constant
2. Substitute values: x = 20 − 9
3. x = 11
Final Answer: x = 11
Mark reminder: method mark; accuracy mark

4. B — 41
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: c² = a² + b²
2. Substitute values: c² = 9² + 40²
3. c² = 81 + 1600
4. c² = 1681
5. c = 41
Final Answer: 41 cm
Mark reminder: method mark for Pythagoras; accuracy mark for hypotenuse

Working:
1. Formula / relationship: Product = first factor × second factor
2. Substitute values: Product = 4 × 4
3. Product = 16
Final Answer: 16
